behaviors.description: Retain four generator planes, source-slot cadence, initial speed, target count and final exit-plane recycling on a continuous authored trough course. Gates remain emitters and recycling boundaries. An explicit floodgate.course_start tie selects the authored source course; unset, missing, or cyclic source courses do not invent an emitter location.
behaviors.selection: Invoked by the tracked WaterSystem application and its presentation/query consumers.

checks.expectation: The retained operation declares each cross-System data route.

Retain four generator planes, source-slot cadence, initial speed, target count and final exit-plane recycling on a continuous authored trough course. Gates remain emitters and recycling boundaries. An explicit floodgate.course_start tie selects the authored source course; unset, missing, or cyclic source courses do not invent an emitter location.
checks.procedure: Verify original generator path fractions, bounded spawn budget and blocked-source handling, identity/mass accounting on recycle, final-plane crossing, escape return and disable/close. Inspect the single-exit retained behavior explicitly; do not pretend unused legacy multi-gate progression was connected. Verify an explicit start selects only its authored chain, invalid/terminal ties and cycles are unavailable, and unset source selection emits no parcels. Recycling must apply the same accepted-coverage, triangle-contact and parcel-clearance checks as new emission; if no source candidate is safe, retain existing material identity/position/velocity and request missing coverage. Run recycling_preserves_existing_material_when_source_is_blocked_or_unknown. Configure operation select_course validates an open authored course before changing its source, null clears it, and targeted source changes preserve existing enabled/count/speed settings.
